announcements.insight: The merger with Infrea is now complete, creating Netelinfra. This follows the October completion of regulatory and meeting steps.

announcements.headline: Netel and Infrea become Netelinfra – a leading Northern European infrastructure services group
announcements.insight: The merger completed in November follows the October sanction. Netelinfra is now a leading Northern European infrastructure services group.

announcements.headline: The merger between Netel and Infrea has been completed
announcements.insight: The merger with Infrea is now complete, following the September prospectus supplement and October regulatory permission. This finalizes the transaction sequence for shareholders.

announcements.headline: The Swedish Companies Registration Office has granted permission to implement the merger plan between Netel and Infrea
announcements.insight: The merger plan with Infrea is now approved by the Swedish Companies Registration Office. This follows the October notice that Netel was well-prepared for the transaction.

announcements.headline: Netel is well-prepared for the merger with Infrea
Notice convening the Extraordinary General Meeting of Netel Holding AB (publ)
announcements.insight: This notice convenes an EGM following the August rights issue information document. Shareholders should monitor the September prospectus supplement for further details.

announcements.headline: Change in number of shares and votes in Netel Holding AB (publ)
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor the rights issue progress following the August meeting. The September prospectus supplement indicates ongoing capital raising steps.

announcements.headline: Netel Holding AB (publ) publishes a supplement to the prospectus in connection with the company's contemplated issue of senior secured bonds
announcements.insight: Following the July rights issue resolution and August shareholder approval, Netel supplements its prospectus for senior secured bonds. This indicates progression in capital raising activities.

announcements.headline: Netel Holding AB (publ) publishes information document in connection with the rights issue
announcements.insight: Following the July board resolution for a SEK 127 million rights issue, this document provides details to shareholders ahead of the August meeting vote.

announcements.headline: Bulletin from Netel Holding AB (publ)’s Extraordinary General Meeting 2026
announcements.insight: The July board resolution for a SEK 127 million rights issue is now being put to shareholders at this EGM. This capital raise supports the proposed merger with Infrea.

announcements.headline: Notice convening the Extraordinary General Meeting of Netel Holding AB (publ)
announcements.insight: This EGM notice follows the July merger prospectus and rights issue resolution. Shareholders must vote to approve the proposed transaction with Infrea.

announcements.headline: The Board of Directors of Netel has resolved on a fully secured rights issue of SEK 127 million and proposes an overallotment issue of up to SEK 75 million
announcements.insight: The board resolved on a fully secured rights issue following earlier intent. This capital raise follows high market activity and a merger prospectus publication.

announcements.headline: Netel publishes merger prospectus regarding the merger with Infrea
announcements.insight: Netel publishes a merger prospectus following its June rights issue. This formal step advances the capital raise and potential consolidation.

announcements.headline: Earnings in line with seasonal patterns – market activity levels remain high
announcements.insight: Netel Holding Ab (Publ) reports earnings aligning with seasonal patterns amid high market activity. This follows the June board resolution regarding a fully secured rights issue.

announcements.headline: The Board of Directors of Netel intends to resolve on a fully secured rights issue of SEK 127 million and to propose an overallotment issue of up to SEK 75 million
announcements.insight: The Board intends to resolve on a fully secured rights issue of SEK 127 million and propose an overallotment issue of up to SEK 75 million.
